description: Canadair Sabre 6, c/n S6-1664, preserved at Wittmundhafen in the markings of Jagdgeschwader 71 Richthofen, the wing's first jet type. The airframe wears the false code 01+06; its true identity is JA+106.
aliases: Sabre 6; Sabre6; CL-13B; JA+106; CL13; CL13B

description: Fokker-built F-104G Starfighter, c/n 8235, preserved at Fliegerhorst Wittmundhafen where JG 71 flew the type from 1963.
Ex-Luftwaffe F-4F Phantom II, c/n 4330, preserved at Wittmundhafen; JG 71 was the last German wing to operate the Phantom, retiring it in 2013.
aliases: F4F; F-4F; Phantom II; PhantomII; F4

description: Spanish-built Hispano HA-1112 M1L Buchón, c/n 194, a Merlin-engined derivative of the Bf 109G, displayed at Wittmundhafen in Second World War Jagdgeschwader 71 lineage markings as 'Black 12' with the false number 27083.
Ex-United States Air Force F-4E Phantom II, c/n 4953, held at Wittmundhafen as a ground instructional airframe inside the base perimeter.
